name: Layout Tech
description: Runs the boundary, hangs ribbon, and keeps the traverse notes clean

name: Timber Cruiser
description: Puts in the cruise plots and calls species, height and defect

name: Compassman / Junior Tech
description: Holds the line, chains distance, and flags what the lead walks past

name: Driver-Swamper
description: Drives the crew truck, walks the road location, and swamps for the crew

name: OFA 3 Attendant
description: Level 3 first aid with the ETV; the crew cannot work without one

name: Mechanic
description: Keeps the trucks, the quad and the saws running
